config.design: Prospective96 pairs: eight new source pairs/task, two formats, three fixed gaps. No replacement based on model outputs. Basis/layer/target position frozen from H848. Native gate per family/format/gap:>=4 valid pairs, >=.75 both-endpoint binary, >=.5 fullvocab intendedgroup. All valid pairs intervened including gate failures, reported separately.
config.fresh_scope: New full prompt/lexical-pair panel relative to H840-H848; some vocabulary/template elements reused and no claim of pretraining or entire-research disjointness. No fitting.
config.distance: Agreement gaps empty/right/over there before near or beside. Sentiment empty/indeed/overall before period. Gaps change wording as well as token distance, not a pure distance manipulation.
config.arms: Full donor preMLP4 relay; own rank1/2/4/8 projected contrast; rank1 complement; othertask rank1; matchednorm random direction plus/minus using H848 random0. Identity and patch-input checks.
config.interpretation: Task contrast compression, not unsupervised manifold recovery. Donor contrast supplies coefficients. Site/coordinate system must stay fixed; no fallback relay selection on failed gap variants.
